tei:div.tei:p: !! ༁ྃ: gnam chos bde chen zhing sgrub kyi dbang 'grig chags su bkod pa bzhugs so:

ka maḥh+y-i: gu ru dhe wa dhā k+ki ni: bde chen zhing gi dbang sgrub ni: maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad dam: yang na 'bru yi 'dab brgyad steng : sku gzugs bum pa tshe gtor dang : lhung bzed rdo rje bshams pa'i bdun: mchod pa rnam lnga mda' dar bsham: sku gzugs rdo rje lhung bzed rnams: tsaka li yin na gzhi steng bsham: na mo dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum: skyabs gnas rnams la skyabs su mchi: 'gro kun sangs rgyas la 'god phyir: byang chub mchog tu bskyed do: ka dag klong nas sprul pa yi: gnam sa gang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin: sman gtor rak+ta lha mor bcas: zad med gyur cig pū dza ho: me tog chu skyes pad+ma'i steng : de nang rang nyid sems dpa' dkar: zhal gcig phyag bzhi thal sbyar dang : g.yas g.yon phreng ba pad+ma 'dzin: rdo rje skyil krung pad zlar bzhugs: bum chu'i steng dang lhung bzed nang : rdo rje'i lte dbus gtor ma'i rtser: sku gzugs pad+ma zla gdan la: 'od dpag med mgon sku mdog dmar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag steng : lhung bzed 'dzin cing chos gos gsol: skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa la: g.yas su 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar: zhal gcig phyag bzhi thal sbyar dang : g.yas g.yon phreng ba pad+ma 'dzin: bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis pad zlar bzhugs: g.yon du phyag rdor mthu chen thob: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog sngo: g.yas g.yon rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: bzhengs pa'i stabs kyi pad zlar bzhugs: sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang: nyan thos dgra bcom dpag med bskor: gtso bo gsum gyi gnas gsum gyis: 'bru gsum las ni 'od 'phros pas: bde ba can nas spyan drangs gyur: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ badz+ra sa ma ya dza: dza hūṃ baṃ ho: tiṣ+ṭha lhan: a ti pu ho: ā+oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ: ar+ghaṃ sogs: hūm̐ bde chen zhing du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: sems can rnams la rtags tu thugs rje gzigs:

dam bca' zhal bzhes 'gro ba'i skyobs mdzad pa: snang mtha' mnyam bzhag mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: lha tshogs sku las 'od zer nub phyogs 'phros: bde chen zhing nas 'od dpag med pa yi: sku dang sngags phreng phyag mtshan dpag med pa: char bzhin babs nas bdag dang dbang lha la: thim pas bum pa bdud rtsis gang bar gyur: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ zhes dang : oṃ bh+rūm̐ swā hā: gnyis brgya las mi nyung bar ci 'grub bzlas byas nas: slob ma mdun 'tshogs khrus dang maṇ+ḍal phul: 'o na da lam khyed rnams la bde ba can gyi zhing khams kyi dbang bskur ba yin te: de yang o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas: mtsho rgyal sprul pa rtog tshogs gtad med gcod: lab kyi sgrol ma zangs ring zhes byar 'byung : zhes lung bstan pa dang : thub pas 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud rgyas pa las: yum chen mo'i sprul pa yin par lung bstan pa ltar: bram ze ār+ya de wa: pha dam pa sangs rgyas: gter ston gra pa mngon shes can la sogs pa rgya bod kyi mkhas grub thams cad kyi yum chen mo dngos yin par thag bcad pa'i ma gcig ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma des sras rgyal ba don grub la mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig tu gdams pa dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gcig pa zhes bya ba las: sangs rgyas myur du thob par 'dod pa la: sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam dag gcig tu smon lam gdab dgos: zhing khams mi 'dra ba bgrang gis mi longs shing : brjod par mtha' chod dka' ba rnams yod tshul gsungs nas: de la bde ba can ma gtogs pa'i gzhan zhing khams rab rnams su skye ba la: sgrib gnyis ma lus pa chod nas: sa brgyad pa yan chod thob dgos: zhing khams 'bring du skye ba la yang : nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa phra ba'i phra ba yang ma lus pa chod nas: sgom lam dang po yan chad thob dgos: zhing khams tha ma na yang bdag 'dzin rtsa ba nas chod cing : bdag med chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong lam thob dgos: mthong lam ma thob kyi bar du smon lam btab kyang mi 'grub:

mthong lam ma thob kyang : dam tshig bslab bya tshul khrims rnams la skyon phra ba'i phra ba tsam yang ma zhugs shing : sdig pa'i dag shan dang : dge ba'i phyogs rnams bsgrubs pa dang : smon lam la 'bad na dga' ldan la sogs pa'i zhing khams chung ngu 'ga' zhig tu skye rung ba tsam yang yod par 'dug ste: de yang dka' bar gda' 'o: zhing khams de rnams su nyon mongs pa'i khrod na gnas pa'i: so so'i skye bo tha mal pa'i skye gnas ni ma yin pas: da rung smon lam ring du gdab par bya'o: de bas na tha mal pa'i gang zag nyon mongs pa can rnams ni: sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skye mi srid pa yin te: 'on kyang sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi smon lam gyi stobs kyis bde ba can gyi zhing khams de ru skye ba ni: mgon po 'od dpag med pa nyid kyis zhal gyis bzhes pa yin pas na: bde ba can du skye ba'i smon lam sgo thams cad nas 'bad dgos so: de yang the tshom dang: som nyi dang : le lo dang : spang blang med par: nges shes dang : brtson 'grus drag po'i sgo nas: bde ba can gyi zhing bkod dang : yon tan rnams dran par byas la smon lam gdab par bya'o: bde ba can gyi zhing khams ni: sangs rgyas gzhan gyi zhing khams las khyad par du lhag pa yin te: de ci'i phyir zhe na: bde ba can du tha mal pa nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa'i so so'i gang zag rnams kyang skye rung bas lhag pa yin pa dang : der skyes nas kyang ci bsam pa'i 'dod pa thams cad kyang bsam ma thag nas 'grub pa yin cing : nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa phra ba tsam gyis kyang mi gos pa dang : gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams gar 'dod du 'gro bas chog pas lhag pa dang : gzhan gyi zhing khams las sangs rgyas pa yang myur bas lhag pa dang : de la sogs pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i: bde ba can las zin thag nye ba'i zhing khams ni gzhan du med pas: bde ba can du skye ba'i smon lam la 'bad pa ni gal shin tu che:

zhes gsungs so: de bzhin du: 'phags pa 'od dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba bkod pa'i mdo las: 'od dpag med kyi mtshan thos shing : dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams zhing der skye ba'i phyir du bsngos na: mtshams med pa lnga dang : chos spangs pa ma gtogs: sgrib pa gzhan yod kyang mi sgrib par: zhing khams der skye ba 'od dpag med kyi smon lam yin par gsungs pas: shin tu skye sla zhing : der skyes nas 'khor bar phyir mi ldog par: sdug bsngal gyi sgra yang mi grags shing : bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i ngang nas sangs rgyas par gsungs pa'i phyir: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa la bar chad med cing lam thag nye ba yin: chos pa bzang po yin kyang smon lam ma btab na: zhing khams de 'drar skye ba'i nges pa'ang med de: rje dkon mchog yan lag gis dge slong chos rin la gdams pa las: chos rnams 'dun pa'i rtse la brten gsungs pas: bsam pa thag pas smon lam gang btab pa: bsam pa bzhin du thams cad 'grub 'gyur bas: skye ba 'di 'og bde ba can nyid dam: dga' ldan 'og min la sogs dag pa'i zhing : dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs drung skye ba sogs: gang du skye 'dod gnas der smon lam thob: bla ma dkon mchog rnams la gsol ba thob: mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la 'phrin las bskul: ma rgan 'gro drug rnams la dge ba bskul: dge ba thams cad de yi don du bsngo: 'grub pa'i mthun 'gyur nged kyis byed pa yin: zhes gdams so: bde ba can gyi smon lam dang : 'od dpag med gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs ni: gsar rnying kun la mang du dar na'ang : zhing khams yongs rdzogs kyi dbang dang sgrub thabs ni sngon chad med pa las sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gsum gser 'phyang gi lo sa ga zla ba'i tshes bdun gyi nyin 'od dpag med gtso 'khor gsum sku ri bo tsam gzi brjid dpag tu med pa dngos su zhal gzigs te dbang dang sgrub thabs dngos su gnang :

slar yang de'i dgong mo 'od dpag med 'khor dang bcas pa dngos su zhal gzigs te: zhal gdams rmi lam gzung ba'i gsol 'debs gnyis gnang ngo : de yang pad+ma bka' thang gter ston brtags pa'i skabs nas: chang dang chu gnyis rno khyad 'gro bas gsal: chos la rno ba'i nus pa 'dug la byed: ces gsungs pa ltar: 'di'i 'pho lung ni 'pho ba gang bas kyang rno ste: rab la zhag gcig: 'bring zhag gnyis: tha ma zhag gsum tsam las mi 'gor bar rtags thon cing : dmigs pa gsal na spyi bor skrangs pa khrag rdol ba sogs 'byung bas yid ches so: ras chung rdo rje grags pa'i mgur las: rig sngags kyi gshog pa brgyangs shes na: dag pa'i zhing du 'gro ba yin: ces gsungs pa ltar: 'di yi bsnyen sgrub la 'bad na: lus 'di bor ma thag tu: bya rgyal rgod pos gnam 'phang gcod pa ltar: bde ba can gyi zhing khams su ta le 'gro chog pa yin: bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas: stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rin po che sna bdun gyis bkang ste sbyin pa byin bas: sangs rgyas 'od dpag med dang bde ba can gyi zhing khams la: dad pa skad cig tsam skyes te: thal mo sbyar na bsod nams che bar gsungs so: 'od dpag med pa'i mtshan thos nas: bsam pa thag pa nas dad pa skad cig tsam skye na: bla na med pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gsungs pa'i phyir: 'od dpag med dang bde ba can gyi zhing khams la dad pa rtse gcig gi ngang nas rjes zlos mdzod: kyai: bla ma 'od dpag med mgon dang : spyan ras gzigs dang mthu chen thob: sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med la: gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur stsol: ces lan gsum brjod: da sa phyogs 'di bde ba can gyi zhing khams bla ma ni spyan ras gzigs 'gro 'dul: dbang rdzas 'od dpag med gtso 'khor rnams mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i drung du: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi sdom pa zhu snyam pas rjes zlos mdzod:

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi: sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags: 'gro ba'i dge la rjes la yi rang: sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung : sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: rang gzhan don gnyis rab bsgrub phyir: byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed par bgyi: byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas: sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer: byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi: 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog: gsum mam tshig rjes ma gsum: da dbang gi gzhi 'god pa'i don du: slob ma khyed rang rnams 'od dpag med gtso 'khor gsum gyi sku 'di ltar du sgoms shig: khyed rang pad+ma zla gdan la: 'od dpag med mgon sku mdog dmar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag steng : lhung bzed 'dzin cing chos gos gsol: skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa la: g.yas su 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar: zhal gcig phyag bzhi thal sbyar dang : g.yas g.yon phreng ba pad+ma 'dzin: bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis pad zlar bzhugs: g.yon du phyag rdor mthu chen thob: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog sngo: g.yas g.yon rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis pad zlar bzhugs: sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang : nyan thos dgra bcom dpag med bskor: gtso bo gsum gyi gnas gsum gyi: 'bru gsum las ni 'od 'phros pas: bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas: 'od dpag med pa'i lha tshogs rnams: kha ba bu yug 'tshubs bzhin byon: slob ma rnams la thim par gyur: hūm̐ 'od dpag med pa'i lha tshogs ma lus rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen dbab tu gsol: skal ldan dad ldan 'di la dbang mchog bskur: log 'dren tshe yi bar chad bsal du gsol: ā+oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥbadz+ra ā wi sha ya a ā: bdun brjod: spos dang rol mo bya: de nas rdo rje mgor bzhag la: brtan par gyur cig tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra:

de nas mda' dar lag tu thogs la: bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi sku las sprul pa'i lha mo mgyogs ma lnga spros te: 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa'i klong nas bro khrig khrig gar khyug khyug mdzad cing g.yon tshe yi bum pas dbang bskur g.yas mda' dar g.yab pa tsam gyis phyi snod kyi 'jig rten nang bcud kyi sems can sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi bcud dang yon tan tshe'i dngos grub thams cad bsdus nas khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim par sgoms shig: hūṃ bcom ldan 'od dpag med mgon ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar: phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag lhung bzed bsnams: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: sprul pa'i lha mo mgyogs ma lngas: tshe bum 'dzin cing mda' dar g.yab: 'byung ba'i bcud bsdus slob mar thim: tshe bsod nyams pa sor chud gyur: hūm̐ mda' dar shar du g.yug pa'i tshe: rlung gi bcud rnams 'dus pa las: 'ja' tshon ljang gu 'od du 'bar: de dbus rlung gi lha mo ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mda' dar ljang : bum pa 'dzin te gar khyug khyug: ljang 'od 'bar ba'i bro khrig khrig: mda' dar lho ru g.yug pa'i tshe: me yi bcud rnams 'dus pa las: 'ja' tshon dmar po 'od du 'bar: de dbus me yi lha mo ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mda' dar dmar: bum pa 'dzin te gar khyug khyug: dmar 'od 'bar ba'i bro khrig khrig: mda' dar nub tu g.yug pa'i tshe: lcags kyi bcud rnams 'dus pa las: 'ja' tshon dkar po 'od du 'bar: de dbus lcags kyi lha mo ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mda' dar dkar: bum pa 'dzin te gar 'khyug khyug: dkar 'od 'bar ba'i bro khrig khrig: mda' dar byang du g.yug pa'i tshe: chu yi bcud rnams 'dus pa las: 'ja' tshon sngon po 'od du 'bar: de dbus chu yi lha mo ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mda' dar sngo: bum pa 'dzin te gar khyug khyug: sngo 'od 'bar ba'i bro khrig khrig:

mda' dar steng du g.yug pa'i tshe: sa yi bcud rnams 'dus pa las: 'ja' tshon ser po 'od du bar: de dbus sa yi lha mo ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mda' dar ser: bum pa 'dzin te gar khyug khyug: ser 'od 'bar ba'i bro khrig khrig: phyogs bzhi steng gi lha mo lngas: 'byung ba lnga yi bkrag bsdus la: slob ma'i bkrag mdangs rgyas par mdzod: phyogs bzhi steng gi lha mo lngas: 'byung ba lnga yi tshe bsdus la: slob ma'i tshe ni brtan par mdzod: phyogs bzhi steng gi lha mo lngas: 'byung ba lnga yi bcud bsdus la: slob ma'i tshe bcud rgyas par mdzod: phyogs bzhi steng gi lha mo lngas: 'byung ba lnga yi 'od bsdus la: slob ma'i 'od ni rgyas par mdzod: tad+ya thā: dha ki ni ha ri ni sa: ma ma ā yuḥsid+dhi pha la puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes brjod mda' dar g.yab cing mgo la bzhag: de nas bum pa lag tu thogs la: bum pa 'di nyid phyi rin po che'i bum pa btsa' ba dang nag po med pa lto ba yangs pa mgrin pa ring ba mchu 'phyang ba lha rdzas kyis gos kyis mgrin pa dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa nang du lnga phrag lnga yi rdzas dang yan lag brgyad ldan chu yis sum gnyis gang ba'i steng du bde ba can gyi zhing khams yongs su rdzogs pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar gsal ba'i 'od dpag med gtso 'khor gyi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bum pa gang : bum pa'i mchu nas dang na ra ra babs: khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs: spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo: mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo: snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo: lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo: spyi gtsug man chad: rkang mthil yan chad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis ltem gyis gang sgrib pa bzhi dag dbang bzhi thob: sku bzhi mngon du byas pa'i skal pa dang ldan par sgoms shig: hūm̐ 'di ni bcom ldan snang mtha' yas: bde ba can gyi zhing khams yin:
khyed kyi mgo la bzhag pa yis: snang ba mtha' yas zhal mthong shog: oṃ āḥhrīḥswā hā: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ:

bum pa mgor bzhag bum chu blud: de nas sku gzugs lag tu thogs: 'di skad du ni brjod par bya: da sku gzugs 'di nyid bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas dngos su gsal ba'i dpral ba: mgrin pa: thugs ka: lte ba: gsang ba lnga nas 'od dpag med kyi sku dkar dmar mthing ser ljang gu'i tshogs sku chung la yan lag dod pa phros: khyod rang gi gnas lngar thim pas sku lnga ye shes lnga'i dbang thob par sgoms shig: hūm̐ 'di ni bcom ldan snang mtha' yas: khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis: bde chen zhing du skyes nas kyang : snang ba mtha' yas zhal mthong shog: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥpañtsa kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: de nas gtor ma lag tu thogs la: gtor ma 'di nyid bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor ba sprin gyi phung po lta bu khyed rang gi spyi bor byon 'od du stim gyis zhu nas khyed rang la thim pas: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang dang byin rlabs thob: tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes 'phel zhing rgyas par sgoms shig: hūm̐ 'di ni bcom ldan snang mtha' yas: sangs rgyas byang sems 'khor gyis bskor: khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis: bde chen zhing du skyes nas kyang : 'od dpag med kyi zhal mthong shog: nyung na gtor ma mgor bzhag: mang na dang po gcig brjod nas dpon slob rnams kyi hrīḥring gi dbyangs bya zhing 'grim: bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa: bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul ba kha lo bsgyur ba: bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa sku tshe dpag tu med pa 'od kyi snang ba mtha' yas pa tshe dang bsod nams dang gzi brjid dpag tu med pas byin gyis rlobs shig: yab 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po bzang po mchog gis byin gyis rlobs shig:

yum gzi brjid can gyis byin gyis rlobs shig: btsun mo rgyal rigs bzang skyong mas byin gyis rlobs shig: sras zla ba'i 'od kyis byin gyis rlobs shig: rim gro snyan pa dri ma med pas byin gyis rlobs shig: shes rab can gyi mchog bzang po'i tog gis byin gyis rlobs shig: rdzu 'phrul dang brtson 'grus can gyi mchog bkod pa chen pos byin gyis rlobs shig: 'khor gyi gtso bo byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dang : mthu chen thob la sogs bye ba khrag khrig dpag tu med pas byin gyis rlobs shig: nyan thos drug khri la sogs pa dge 'dun dpag tu med pas byin gyis rlobs shig: pad+ma'i 'od zer las sprul pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba dung phyur dpag tu med pas byin gyis rlobs shig: nyin re bzhin phyogs bcu nas byon pas sangs rgyas dpag tu med pas byin gyis rlobs shig: ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od zer kun nas 'phags pa'i dpal brtsegs kyi rgyal pos byin gyis rlobs shig: de bzhin gshegs pa rab tu brtan pa yon tan nor bu brtsegs pa'i rgyal pos byin gyis rlobs shig: tshe 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs shig: bsod nams rgyas par byin gyis rlobs shig: nad zhi bar byin gyis rlobs shig: gdon las grol bar byin gyis rlobs shig: sdig sgrib zhi bar byin gyis rlobs shig: 'chi ba'i dus sprul pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med mthong bar byin gyis rlobs shig: tshe 'phos nas bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs shig: skyes ma thag tu me tog pad+ma'i kha phye nas sangs rgyas 'od dpag med mngon sum du mjal bar byin gyis rlobs shig: sangs rgyas mchod cing chos ston pa dang mi 'bral bar byin gyis rlobs shig: sa lam gyi yon tan rdzogs nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par byin gyis rlobs shig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ a mi dhe wa ā yuḥsid+dhi hūṃ:

kā ya wā ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: de nas rdo rje lag tu thogs: da pad+ma rā ga las grub pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'di: yar gyi rwa lnga rgyal ba rigs lnga: 'dab ma brgyad sems dpa' brgyad: mar gyi rwa lnga yum lnga: 'dab ma brgyad sems ma brgyad mtshon pa yin la: lte ba kun zlum thig le'i klong du sangs rgyas 'od dpag med gtso 'khor gsal ba khyed rang la thim pas thugs rig pa rtsal gyi dbang thob ste: rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skye bar sgoms shig: hūṃ 'di ni 'od dpag med mgon la: sangs rgyas byang sems 'khor gyis bskor: khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis: 'od dpag med mgon dbang thob nas: bde ba can du skye bar shog: oṃ hrīḥswā hā: badz+ra ñdzā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: lhung bzed lag tu thogs la: da bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa'i phyag mtshan bai ḍūr+ya'i lhung bzed 'di yi nang na ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi la rnam pa tshe nas dang tshe zan dang tshe ril gyis bkang ba'i steng na 'od dpag med gtso 'khor rnams bzhugs pa khyed rang la thim pas bde ba can du skyes nas zhing khams kyi dpal la longs spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par sgoms shig: hūm̐ 'di ni 'od dpag med mgon te: khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis: bde chen zhing du skyes nas kyang : 'od dpag med pa'i zhal mthong shog: oṃ bh+rūṃ swā hā: pun+ya gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: bsdu na lhung bzed 'grim rjes sam: khrom pa 'grim tshar ba'i skabs sam: spro na bar mtshams thams cad du: nas gtor bkra shis brjod: hūṃ bde chen zhing du chos kyi 'khor lo skor: sems can rnams la rtag tu thugs rje gzigs: dam bca' zhal bzhes 'gro ba'i skyabs mdzad pa: snang mtha' mnyam bzhag mdzad pa'i bkra shis shog: ces sbyar ro: de nas rgyas par 'dod na: tshe dbang rgyas pa nas byung ba'i bkra shis rtags brgyad: rgyal srid sna bdun gnyis ka'am gang rung sbyar la:

de nas tshe chang ngam bum chu sbyin cing : hūm̐ skyes bu rigs kyi bu khyod la: tshe chang bdud rtsi 'di byin pas: rtag tu tshe ni ring nus pa'i: dbang dang ldan nas tshe 'phel shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ a mi dhe wa ā yuḥsid+dhi hūṃ: de nas tshe ril byin cing : hūṃ skyes bu rigs kyi bu khyod la: tshe ril 'di nyid byin pa yis: khyod nyid rdo rje'i sku 'grub pa'i: dbang dang ldan nas tshe 'phel shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ a mi dhe wa ā yuḥsid+dhi hūṃ: gong gi tshe 'gugs mda' dar dang : bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid dang : tshe ril tshe chang bde rnams ni: so sar med pa'i nad pa la: log lta skye phyir mi rung ngo : da khyed rang rnams kyis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ci yod pa thams cad dang : da res dbang zhus pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar gyur cig bsam pa gyis la rjes zlos mdzod: e ma hoḥ ngo mtshar sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas dang : g.yas su jo bo thugs rje chen po dang : g.yon du sems dpa' mthu chen thob rnams la: sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med 'khor gyis bskor: bde skyid ngo mtshar dpag tu med pa yi: bde ba can zhes bya ba'i zhing khams der: bdag ni 'di ni tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: skye ba gzhan gyi bar ma chod pa ru: de ru skyes nas snang mtha'i zhal mthong shog: de skad bdag gis smon lam btab pa 'di: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis: gegs med 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol: tad+ya thā: pañtsa dri ya a wa bho dha na ya swā hā: 'o de ltar dbang thob nas: rnga sgra'i rgyal po'i gzungs las: 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na: bde ba can gyi zhing khams yod: de na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs: de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med: su zhig de yi mtshan 'dzin pa: de ni de ru skye bar 'gyur: 'chi ba'i dus su ston pa ni: dge slong dge 'dun bcas te mthong :

zhes gsungs pa'i phyir: rab 'di'i bsgrub pa rtags thon dang : cho ga rgyun khyer: 'bring mngon rtogs nyung ngu dang bsnyen pa rgyun khyer: de yang mi shes na: sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo: mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo: zhes pa phreng skor re'i 'jug tu bde ba can du skye bar shog: de ma chag par rgyun du byas na: bar dor 'od dpag med zhal mjal zhing : bde ba can du skye ba ni: sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi stobs yin par ston pa shākya thub pas mdo sde mang po nas gsungs pa'i phyir: de ltar du bya snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa: de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi: deng nas brtsam te bdag bran du: khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags kyis: khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang : cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol: sa gzhi spos kyis sogs: de ni phyag len rgyas pa yin la: gal te nad pa 'chi la khad la dbang brgya byed na: tshe 'gugs: bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid : tshe chang tshe ril bskyur ba'i dbang rgyas pa gcig bskur: de nas gsol 'debs sh+lau ka gcig: dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs sogs rjes zlos bya: de nas tshig lhug dmigs pa rnams yid kyis bsgom ngag tu mi brjod par: bum pa: sku gzugs: gtor ma: rdo rje: lhung bzed rnams tshigs bcad dang sngags kho na bskur te: dbang rdzas de lnga rdzogs pa dbang gcig tu brtsis pa'i grangs bzung : bskur thengs re la bcu bco lnga du thon gyi mgo nas sa gzhi spos byug re dang : mjug tu gtso bos ji ltar sbyar: bar skabs su dbang bsgrub re byas la bsnyen pa ci 'grub bzlas: nad pa 'chi nges la de las lhag pa'i phan thogs bya rgyu med do: gal te khrom chen la bskur na: mda' dar khri kha nas g.yug pas chog: bum pa bum chu 'grim: bkra shis brjod: nas gtor: sku tsaka li gtor ma la btsugs la 'grims:

yang bkra shis: rdo rje dang : bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid rnams khrom la bstan nas 'grim tshul byed cing lhung bzed du bcug la dus gcig la 'grim: de dang mnyam du mchod g.yog pa gnyis kyis tshe chang dang tshe ril 'gyed: tshe chang dang tshe ril med kyang rung : de dag gi tshe hrīḥdabyangs dang : oṃ bh+rūṃ swā hā:dang : sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo: mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo: zhes pa rnams go rim med par gang zin khrom la 'ur 'don bcug go: de ltar dbang bsgrub dbang bskur dmigs rim rnams: gter gzhung mi gsal ngag nas shes dgos shing : tshe 'gugs mtha' rten la sogs bsab 'os dang : phan yon dgos khyad tshad ldan lung dang bcas: 'grel tshad 'gro ba 'dren 'dod sems bskyed nas: bya lo 'bum 'gyur zla ba'i yar tshes la: gter blon rā ga a s+yas bsgrigs pa yi: yi ge ri khrod dge slong sbyin pas bris: so skye'i dbang gis nyes 'gal mchis srid na: lha dang chos bdag srung ma'i drung du bshags: dge bas dbang 'di'i 'brel pa thogs tshad kun: skye ba gzhan gyis bar mtshams mi chod par: bde ba can du nges par skye gyur cig: maṅga laṃ/// /
